author: Lumminous_164
quote: Bro, I’m honestly sad. It’s a buggy mess which I can’t even play without finding a bug, my PS is literally doing its best to keep the game going but I think it’s on the verge of death, it’s overrated af and I really can’t understand how people are so obsessed with it, and finally the freaking 99 score. Rockstar is a freaking dishonest company that freaking payed idk how many reviewers just to get that perfect score, be real! Due to all the controversy and bugs, I can’t even enjoy the game without getting stuck in the fridge trying to get a freaking beer!
